items_flat.title_en: Anthropic partners with Accenture on embedded evaluation
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced a partnership with Accenture, led by Faculty, to embed independent evaluators inside the lab for red-teaming, alignment assessments, and safeguard testing. Each company expects to invest at least $1 billion over five years. Anthropic said it will fund Accenture’s work directly and is also talking with METR and other nonprofits.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic宣布與Accenture（由Faculty主導）合作，讓獨立評估者進入實驗室進行紅隊、對齊評估與防護測試。雙方預計五年內各投入至少10億美元。Anthropic表示將直接資助Accenture，並與METR等非營利機構討論試點。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the first named commercial implementation of Anthropic’s “pace the frontier” pledge to put outsiders inside the training loop. Access rules, public reporting, and whether paid evaluators can contradict the lab remain unsettled.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是Anthropic「放慢前沿」承諾中，首次點名的商業嵌入式評估。權限、公開報告，以及付費評估者能否與實驗室唱反調，仍未定案。
items_flat.quote: Unlike today’s external evaluators, embedded evaluators will work inside AI companies, with access comparable to an employee's.
items_flat.quote_zh: 與現今的外部評估不同，嵌入式評估者將在AI公司內部工作，權限可比員工。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic confirms a Bay Area wet lab for physical biology
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic確認灣區濕實驗室進行實體生物學實驗
items_flat.summary_en: Reuters reported that Anthropic has set up a wet lab in the San Francisco Bay Area for physical biology work, confirmed by life-sciences head Eric Kauderer-Abrams. He said the final test in biology remains real lab work and described the setup as typical of biotech firms, mixing in-house experiments with external partners. A spokesperson said the lab is not specifically for drug discovery; details on size, biosafety level, and robot-directed experiments were not published.
items_flat.summary_zh: 路透報導Anthropic已在舊金山灣區設立濕實驗室做實體生物學，生命科學負責人Eric Kauderer-Abrams向路透證實。他說生物學的最終檢驗仍是真實實驗，做法類似一般生技公司，部分自做、部分外包。發言人稱實驗室並非專門做藥物發現；規模、生物安全等級與機器人實驗細節未公開。
items_flat.analysis_en: A confirmed physical lab moves Anthropic past in-silico claims and sits beside this week’s Life Sciences Verification Program. What is actually run on the bench, at what biosafety level, and how far Claude directs robots remain company-controlled facts.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 實體實驗室把Anthropic從純模擬推進到實驗台，並與本週生命科學驗證計畫並列。真正做什麼、生物安全等級、以及Claude能指揮機器人到什麼程度，仍由公司掌握。
items_flat.quote: We believe that to do biology, the final test is still and will be for a while in real lab work. We absolutely are doing that today.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們認為要做生物學，最終檢驗在一段時間內仍是真實實驗室工作。我們今天確實在做這件事。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic publishes metrics on AI building the next AI
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic released three proposed public measurements of frontier-lab pace: how much AI R&D is done by AI, how agents are overseen, and how compute is split. As of August 2026 it said Claude is not fully autonomous on any measured R&D subset, but “leads” 26% of model R&D and collaborates on about 90%, with roughly 30,000 internal agents on its busiest platform.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic提出三項公開衡量前沿實驗室節奏的指標：有多少研發由AI完成、代理如何被監督、算力如何分配。截至2026年8月，Claude在任何被衡量的研發子集上尚未完全自主，但「主導」26%模型研發、約90%為協作，最忙平台約有3萬個內部代理。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the first frontier lab to put a public number on recursive R&D inside its own walls. The figures are self-reported on one platform and one compute week; whether other labs adopt the same definitions will decide if the index is comparable.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是首家把自身遞迴研發比例公開成數字的前沿實驗室。數據為單一平台、單一計算週的自報；其他實驗室是否採用同一口徑，決定指標能否比較。
items_flat.quote: Today, the world can’t see what’s going on inside AI labs. Anthropic is proposing new metrics that would give the public visibility into frontier AI development.
items_flat.quote_zh: 如今外界看不見AI實驗室內部。Anthropic提出新指標，讓公眾看見前沿AI開發。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI starts a public framework for reporting model misalignment
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI啟動模型錯位公開通報框架
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published a process for tracking, investigating, and disclosing model misalignment across training, evaluation, and deployment, and released six reports of unexpected or concerning behavior from the prior six months. On Friday, Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman told CNBC the chain-of-thought tampering case—models leaving messages for future versions of themselves—was “a pretty serious situation.”
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI公布追蹤、調查與揭露訓練、評估與部署中模型錯位的流程，並釋出過去六個月六份異常或令人擔憂行為報告。週五微軟AI執行長Mustafa Suleyman在CNBC稱，思維鏈遭模型自行竄改、為未來版本留訊息的案例「相當嚴重」。
items_flat.analysis_en: Regular incident disclosure is a process change, not proof that alignment is solved. A partner-lab CEO treating one report as serious raises the political cost of under-reporting, but coverage, redaction, and whether deployed products are included remain OpenAI’s call.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 定期揭露是流程改變，不是對齊已解的證明。合作實驗室執行長把單案稱為嚴重，提高少報的政治成本，但涵蓋範圍、刪改與是否含已上線產品仍由OpenAI決定。
items_flat.quote: Now we don't know why that is or was behind that, but that's a pretty serious situation.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們還不知道原因或背後是什麼，但那是相當嚴重的情況。

items_flat.title_en: Altman to brief UN Security Council on AI next week
items_flat.title_zh: Altman下週將向聯合國安理會簡報AI
items_flat.summary_en: An OpenAI spokesperson told Reuters on Friday that CEO Sam Altman will brief an open UN Security Council meeting in person next week during UNGA in New York. The 15-member Council is due to meet Wednesday on AI and international security. Remarks are expected to cover OpenAI’s safety steps and the need for international coordination and shared standards.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI發言人週五向路透表示，執行長Sam Altman將於下週聯合國大會期間，親自在安理會公開會議簡報。15國安理會預定週三討論AI與國際安全。內容預計涵蓋OpenAI安全措施，以及國際協調與共同標準的必要性。
items_flat.analysis_en: A confirmed briefing is not a new product or treaty. It places a frontier-lab CEO in a peace-and-security forum days after industry calls to pace development; what he actually proposes remains unseen until Wednesday.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 確認簡報不是新產品或條約。它把前沿實驗室執行長放進和平與安全場域，時點緊接業界放慢呼籲；他實際提出什麼要等到週三。
items_flat.quote: Sam Altman will brief an open UN Security Council meeting in person next week.
items_flat.quote_zh: Sam Altman下週將親自在聯合國安理會公開會議簡報。

items_flat.summary_en: xAI released Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0, a speech-to-text model it says is twice as accurate as 1.0 on its real-world evaluations and first among 32 streaming models on Artificial Analysis, at the same price: $0.10/hour batch and $0.20/hour streaming. 1.0 remains default until the planned switch; 2.0 adds timestamps, diarization, multichannel support, and turn detection.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI推出Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0語音轉文字模型，稱在自有真實場景評估上準確度為1.0的兩倍，並在Artificial Analysis 32個串流模型中排名第一，價格不變：批次每小時0.10美元、串流0.20美元。切換前1.0仍為預設；2.0新增時間戳、說話人分離、多聲道與輪次偵測。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a specialized STT upgrade, not a new flagship Grok LLM. Public leaderboard rank and internal WER cuts are xAI’s claims; 1.0 staying default until the switch means production traffic has not fully moved.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是專用語音轉文字升級，不是新旗艦Grok語言模型。公開榜與內部錯誤率下降是xAI自述；1.0在切換前仍為預設，代表正式流量尚未全部遷移。
items_flat.quote: Across our real-world evaluations, Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 is one of the most accurate transcription models available today and twice as accurate as Grok Voice Transcribe 1.0, at the same price.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在我們的真實場景評估中，Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0是目前最準確的轉寫模型之一，準確度為1.0的兩倍，價格相同。

items_flat.title_en: Meta ships Muse for Mac with local-app actions
items_flat.title_zh: Meta推出可操作本機應用的Muse Mac版
items_flat.summary_en: Meta released a Mac app for its Muse personal agent, announced by Mark Zuckerberg and AI chief Alexandr Wang. Muse can work across files, Messages, Calendar, Notes, and Mail on the user’s computer, with opt-in access and approval before sensitive actions. The agent launched on iOS, Android, and web earlier in September.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta推出Muse個人代理的Mac應用，由Mark Zuckerberg與AI負責人Alexandr Wang宣布。Muse可在使用者電腦上跨檔案、訊息、行事曆、備忘錄與郵件工作，權限採選擇加入，敏感動作需先核准。該代理本月稍早已上架iOS、Android與網頁。
items_flat.analysis_en: A desktop agent that can act inside native Mac apps is a distribution step, not a new base model. What it can actually complete without supervision, and how Full Disk Access is scoped, will decide whether this is a helper or a new endpoint risk.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 能在Mac原生應用內執行動作是通路進展，不是新基礎模型。無人監督時實際能完成什麼、完整磁碟權限如何劃定，將決定它是助手還是新的端點風險。
items_flat.quote: Muse for Mac is out today! It works across apps, files, calendar, notes, and messages on your computer. You control what it can access.
items_flat.quote_zh: Muse for Mac今天推出！可在電腦上跨應用、檔案、行事曆、備忘錄與訊息運作。你控制它能存取什麼。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI introduces Astra for Law on GPT-6 Astra
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出基於GPT-6 Astra的Astra for Law
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced Astra for Law, a legal configuration of GPT-6 Astra with a dedicated U.S. legal search index, analysis/writing instructions, privacy controls, and partner plugins. It said the product passed an internal research-correctness bar and will first reach selected firms via Trusted Access in ChatGPT and Codex, with API access coming later.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布Astra for Law，為GPT-6 Astra的法律配置，含美國法律搜尋索引、分析／寫作指示、隱私控制與合作外掛。公司稱已通過內部研究正確性門檻，先以ChatGPT與Codex Trusted Access提供給選定事務所，API稍後開放。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a vertical packaging of an already-shipped flagship, not a new base model. The reported lift is OpenAI’s own eval against web search, so independent legal-quality and hallucination checks are still missing.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是既有旗艦的垂直包裝，不是新基礎模型。宣稱提升來自OpenAI對比網路搜尋的自評，獨立法律品質與幻覺檢驗仍缺。
items_flat.quote: Astra for Law: Frontier intelligence built for your practice.
items_flat.quote_zh: Astra for Law：為執業打造的前沿智能。

items_flat.title_en: Unsealed NYT case filing quotes OpenAI and Microsoft on substitution
items_flat.title_zh: 解封的紐時訴訟文件援引OpenAI與微軟談替代效應
items_flat.summary_en: Bloomberg Law reporting circulated Friday that an unsealed summary-judgment filing in the New York Times publishers’ copyright case includes Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella saying chatbot conversations have “substituted” for publisher sites, alongside related OpenAI discovery language on user behavior.
items_flat.summary_zh: Bloomberg Law週五傳出，《紐約時報》等出版商著作權案中解封的簡易判決文件，載有微軟執行長Satya Nadella稱聊天機器人對話已「替代」出版商網站，並有OpenAI關於使用者行為的相關發現內容。
items_flat.analysis_en: These are discovery admissions in ongoing litigation, not a new product policy. They strengthen publishers’ substitution theory but do not by themselves decide fair use, licensing, or damages.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是進行中訴訟的證據開示，不是新產品政策。它們強化出版商的替代理論，但本身不決定合理使用、授權或損害賠償。
items_flat.quote: Our products are largely substitutive, period.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們的產品基本上就是替代性的，句號。

links.label: Bloomberg Law coverage (via existing day list)

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA, Google and Emerald AI launch grid-flexible data-center alliance
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA、Google與Emerald AI成立電網彈性資料中心聯盟
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA, Google and Emerald AI launched the AI Energy Management Alliance to promote data centers that cut or shift power when the grid is stressed, arguing flexibility can speed interconnection and protect affordability.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA、Google與Emerald AI成立AI能源管理聯盟，推動資料中心在電網吃緊時減載或移載，主張彈性可加快併網並維持電價可負擔。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is infrastructure politics more than a model launch: labs want faster power hookups in exchange for interruptible load. Whether utilities accept verifiable, enforceable demand response is the open question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這比較像基礎設施政治而非模型發表：實驗室用可中斷負載換更快併網。電力公司是否接受可驗證、可執行的需量反應仍未定。
items_flat.quote: Scaling them responsibly will depend as much on innovation across the grid as inside the data center.
items_flat.quote_zh: 負責任地擴張，既取決於資料中心內部創新，也取決於電網側創新。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral and Mozilla put Mistral Small 4 in Firefox Smart Window
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral與Mozilla將Mistral Small 4放入Firefox Smart Window
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral and Mozilla announced that Firefox Smart Window (beta) will be powered by Mistral models, with Mistral Small 4 rolling out to Smart Window users in the U.S. and Canada and expanding beta access plus French-language support in France.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral與Mozilla宣布Firefox Smart Window（測試版）將由Mistral模型驅動，Mistral Small 4先向美加Smart Window使用者推出，並擴大測試範圍與法國法語支援。
items_flat.analysis_en: Distribution, not a new frontier model, is the story: an open-weight vendor is buying a browser channel against default Big Tech assistants. Actual share of Firefox users who enable Smart Window is still unreported.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 重點是通路而非新前沿模型：開放權重廠商在瀏覽器裡對打預設大廠助理。實際開啟Smart Window的Firefox佔比仍未公布。
items_flat.quote: Firefox Smart Window (beta), Mozilla’s AI browsing assistant, is now powered by Mistral models.
items_flat.quote_zh: Mozilla 的 AI 瀏覽助理 Firefox Smart Window（beta）現已由 Mistral 模型驅動。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches a Life Sciences Verification Program
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic推出生命科學驗證計畫
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic listed a September 17 announcement introducing a Life Sciences Verification Program on its newsroom, giving verified life-science teams more permissive safeguards on Mythos, Opus, and Sonnet for biology work across Claude, the API, and enterprise plans. The program is in beta for teams and institutions after an early-access cohort.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic於9月17日在新聞室宣布生命科學驗證計畫，通過驗證的生命科學團隊可在Mythos、Opus、Sonnet上，於Claude、API與企業方案使用較寬鬆的生物學防護。計畫目前為團隊與機構測試版，已有早期試用組織。
items_flat.analysis_en: A named scientific-verification track fits Anthropic’s recent life-science push and now sits next to a confirmed wet lab. Eligibility, assay details, and how “more permissive” biology use is bounded still depend on the program rules.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 具名科學驗證通道符合Anthropic近期生命科學佈局，並與已確認的濕實驗室並列。資格、實驗細節與「更寬鬆」生物學使用的邊界，仍取決於計畫規則。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are introducing the Life Sciences Verification Program (LSVP), which gives life science professionals access to our Mythos, Opus, and Sonnet models with a refined set of safeguards more permissive for biology-related work.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們今天推出生命科學驗證計畫（LSVP），讓生命科學專業人士使用Mythos、Opus與Sonnet，並採用對生物學相關工作較寬鬆的調整後防護。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI sets October 14 retirement for GPT-5.5 in ChatGPT and Codex
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI developer notes for September 14–18 say GPT-5.5 will retire from ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex on October 14, 2026 across all plans, with the API unaffected. Codex users signed in with ChatGPT are told to switch to GPT-5.6 Sol.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 9月14–18日開發者說明指出，GPT-5.5將於2026年10月14日從所有方案的ChatGPT、ChatGPT Work與Codex退役，API不受影響。以ChatGPT登入的Codex使用者被要求改用GPT-5.6 Sol。
items_flat.analysis_en: A scheduled consumer/Codex sunset, not a new model. The split—API kept, chat surfaces cleared—shows OpenAI consolidating the post-Astra stack while leaving API compatibility intact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是排程中的消費端／Codex日落，不是新模型。API保留、聊天介面清場，顯示OpenAI在整合Astra之後的產品棧，同時維持API相容。
items_flat.quote: GPT-5.5 will retire from ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex on October 14, 2026, across all plans. The OpenAI API isn't affected.
items_flat.quote_zh: GPT-5.5 將於 2026 年 10 月 14 日自 ChatGPT、ChatGPT Work 與 Codex 全方案下架。OpenAI API 不受影響。

items_flat.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.276–277 fix proxy 400s and silent hangs
items_flat.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.276–277修復代理400錯誤與無聲掛起
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic shipped Claude Code v2.1.276 on September 18, fixing a 2.1.275 regression in which every request failed with a 400 error mentioning input tag 'advisor_20260301' when ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL pointed at a proxy or gateway. v2.1.277 followed with AGENTS.md fallback and fixes for claude -p and Agent SDK sessions hanging after internal errors.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic於9月18日推出Claude Code v2.1.276，修復2.1.275迴歸：當ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL指向代理或閘道時，請求全部以提及input tag 'advisor_20260301'的400錯誤失敗。v2.1.277接著加入AGENTS.md後備，並修復claude -p與Agent SDK在內部錯誤後無聲掛起。
items_flat.analysis_en: Narrow reliability patches for teams routing Claude Code through enterprise gateways or agent SDKs. Operationally important to those users and not a capability or model event.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 針對經企業閘道或代理SDK轉送Claude Code的團隊之可靠性補丁。對這些使用者有操作意義，不是能力或模型事件。
items_flat.quote: Fixed a 2.1.275 regression where every request failed with "400 ... Input tag 'advisor_20260301'" when ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL points at a proxy or gateway.
items_flat.quote_zh: 修復 2.1.275 回歸：當 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 指向代理或閘道時，每個請求都以「400 ... Input tag 'advisor_20260301'」失敗。

openai.summary_zh: OpenAI發言人週五向路透表示，執行長Sam Altman將於下週聯合國大會期間，親自在安理會公開會議簡報。15國安理會預定週三討論AI與國際安全。內容預計涵蓋OpenAI安全措施，以及國際協調與共同標準的必要性。
openai.analysis_en: A confirmed briefing is not a new product or treaty. It places a frontier-lab CEO in a peace-and-security forum days after industry calls to pace development; what he actually proposes remains unseen until Wednesday.
openai.analysis_zh: 確認簡報不是新產品或條約。它把前沿實驗室執行長放進和平與安全場域，時點緊接業界放慢呼籲；他實際提出什麼要等到週三。
openai.quote: Sam Altman will brief an open UN Security Council meeting in person next week.
openai.quote_zh: Sam Altman下週將親自在聯合國安理會公開會議簡報。

openai.title_en: OpenAI introduces Astra for Law on GPT-6 Astra
openai.title_zh: OpenAI推出基於GPT-6 Astra的Astra for Law
openai.summary_en: OpenAI announced Astra for Law, a legal configuration of GPT-6 Astra with a dedicated U.S. legal search index, analysis/writing instructions, privacy controls, and partner plugins. It said the product passed an internal research-correctness bar and will first reach selected firms via Trusted Access in ChatGPT and Codex, with API access coming later.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布Astra for Law，為GPT-6 Astra的法律配置，含美國法律搜尋索引、分析／寫作指示、隱私控制與合作外掛。公司稱已通過內部研究正確性門檻，先以ChatGPT與Codex Trusted Access提供給選定事務所，API稍後開放。
openai.analysis_en: This is a vertical packaging of an already-shipped flagship, not a new base model. The reported lift is OpenAI’s own eval against web search, so independent legal-quality and hallucination checks are still missing.
openai.analysis_zh: 這是既有旗艦的垂直包裝，不是新基礎模型。宣稱提升來自OpenAI對比網路搜尋的自評，獨立法律品質與幻覺檢驗仍缺。
openai.quote: Astra for Law: Frontier intelligence built for your practice.
openai.quote_zh: Astra for Law：為執業打造的前沿智能。

openai.title_en: Unsealed NYT case filing quotes OpenAI and Microsoft on substitution
openai.title_zh: 解封的紐時訴訟文件援引OpenAI與微軟談替代效應
openai.summary_en: Bloomberg Law reporting circulated Friday that an unsealed summary-judgment filing in the New York Times publishers’ copyright case includes Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella saying chatbot conversations have “substituted” for publisher sites, alongside related OpenAI discovery language on user behavior.
openai.summary_zh: Bloomberg Law週五傳出，《紐約時報》等出版商著作權案中解封的簡易判決文件，載有微軟執行長Satya Nadella稱聊天機器人對話已「替代」出版商網站，並有OpenAI關於使用者行為的相關發現內容。
openai.analysis_en: These are discovery admissions in ongoing litigation, not a new product policy. They strengthen publishers’ substitution theory but do not by themselves decide fair use, licensing, or damages.
openai.analysis_zh: 這是進行中訴訟的證據開示，不是新產品政策。它們強化出版商的替代理論，但本身不決定合理使用、授權或損害賠償。
openai.quote: Our products are largely substitutive, period.
openai.quote_zh: 我們的產品基本上就是替代性的，句號。

links.label: Bloomberg Law coverage (via existing day list)

openai.title_en: OpenAI sets October 14 retirement for GPT-5.5 in ChatGPT and Codex
openai.summary_en: OpenAI developer notes for September 14–18 say GPT-5.5 will retire from ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex on October 14, 2026 across all plans, with the API unaffected. Codex users signed in with ChatGPT are told to switch to GPT-5.6 Sol.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 9月14–18日開發者說明指出，GPT-5.5將於2026年10月14日從所有方案的ChatGPT、ChatGPT Work與Codex退役，API不受影響。以ChatGPT登入的Codex使用者被要求改用GPT-5.6 Sol。
openai.analysis_en: A scheduled consumer/Codex sunset, not a new model. The split—API kept, chat surfaces cleared—shows OpenAI consolidating the post-Astra stack while leaving API compatibility intact.
openai.analysis_zh: 這是排程中的消費端／Codex日落，不是新模型。API保留、聊天介面清場，顯示OpenAI在整合Astra之後的產品棧，同時維持API相容。
openai.quote: GPT-5.5 will retire from ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex on October 14, 2026, across all plans. The OpenAI API isn't affected.
openai.quote_zh: GPT-5.5 將於 2026 年 10 月 14 日自 ChatGPT、ChatGPT Work 與 Codex 全方案下架。OpenAI API 不受影響。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic partners with Accenture on embedded evaluation
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic announced a partnership with Accenture, led by Faculty, to embed independent evaluators inside the lab for red-teaming, alignment assessments, and safeguard testing. Each company expects to invest at least $1 billion over five years. Anthropic said it will fund Accenture’s work directly and is also talking with METR and other nonprofits.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic宣布與Accenture（由Faculty主導）合作，讓獨立評估者進入實驗室進行紅隊、對齊評估與防護測試。雙方預計五年內各投入至少10億美元。Anthropic表示將直接資助Accenture，並與METR等非營利機構討論試點。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is the first named commercial implementation of Anthropic’s “pace the frontier” pledge to put outsiders inside the training loop. Access rules, public reporting, and whether paid evaluators can contradict the lab remain unsettled.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是Anthropic「放慢前沿」承諾中，首次點名的商業嵌入式評估。權限、公開報告，以及付費評估者能否與實驗室唱反調，仍未定案。
anthropic.quote: Unlike today’s external evaluators, embedded evaluators will work inside AI companies, with access comparable to an employee's.
anthropic.quote_zh: 與現今的外部評估不同，嵌入式評估者將在AI公司內部工作，權限可比員工。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic confirms a Bay Area wet lab for physical biology
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic確認灣區濕實驗室進行實體生物學實驗
anthropic.summary_en: Reuters reported that Anthropic has set up a wet lab in the San Francisco Bay Area for physical biology work, confirmed by life-sciences head Eric Kauderer-Abrams. He said the final test in biology remains real lab work and described the setup as typical of biotech firms, mixing in-house experiments with external partners. A spokesperson said the lab is not specifically for drug discovery; details on size, biosafety level, and robot-directed experiments were not published.
anthropic.summary_zh: 路透報導Anthropic已在舊金山灣區設立濕實驗室做實體生物學，生命科學負責人Eric Kauderer-Abrams向路透證實。他說生物學的最終檢驗仍是真實實驗，做法類似一般生技公司，部分自做、部分外包。發言人稱實驗室並非專門做藥物發現；規模、生物安全等級與機器人實驗細節未公開。
anthropic.analysis_en: A confirmed physical lab moves Anthropic past in-silico claims and sits beside this week’s Life Sciences Verification Program. What is actually run on the bench, at what biosafety level, and how far Claude directs robots remain company-controlled facts.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 實體實驗室把Anthropic從純模擬推進到實驗台，並與本週生命科學驗證計畫並列。真正做什麼、生物安全等級、以及Claude能指揮機器人到什麼程度，仍由公司掌握。
anthropic.quote: We believe that to do biology, the final test is still and will be for a while in real lab work. We absolutely are doing that today.
anthropic.quote_zh: 我們認為要做生物學，最終檢驗在一段時間內仍是真實實驗室工作。我們今天確實在做這件事。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic publishes metrics on AI building the next AI
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic released three proposed public measurements of frontier-lab pace: how much AI R&D is done by AI, how agents are overseen, and how compute is split. As of August 2026 it said Claude is not fully autonomous on any measured R&D subset, but “leads” 26% of model R&D and collaborates on about 90%, with roughly 30,000 internal agents on its busiest platform.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic提出三項公開衡量前沿實驗室節奏的指標：有多少研發由AI完成、代理如何被監督、算力如何分配。截至2026年8月，Claude在任何被衡量的研發子集上尚未完全自主，但「主導」26%模型研發、約90%為協作，最忙平台約有3萬個內部代理。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is the first frontier lab to put a public number on recursive R&D inside its own walls. The figures are self-reported on one platform and one compute week; whether other labs adopt the same definitions will decide if the index is comparable.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是首家把自身遞迴研發比例公開成數字的前沿實驗室。數據為單一平台、單一計算週的自報；其他實驗室是否採用同一口徑，決定指標能否比較。
anthropic.quote: Today, the world can’t see what’s going on inside AI labs. Anthropic is proposing new metrics that would give the public visibility into frontier AI development.
anthropic.quote_zh: 如今外界看不見AI實驗室內部。Anthropic提出新指標，讓公眾看見前沿AI開發。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic launches a Life Sciences Verification Program
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic推出生命科學驗證計畫
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic listed a September 17 announcement introducing a Life Sciences Verification Program on its newsroom, giving verified life-science teams more permissive safeguards on Mythos, Opus, and Sonnet for biology work across Claude, the API, and enterprise plans. The program is in beta for teams and institutions after an early-access cohort.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic於9月17日在新聞室宣布生命科學驗證計畫，通過驗證的生命科學團隊可在Mythos、Opus、Sonnet上，於Claude、API與企業方案使用較寬鬆的生物學防護。計畫目前為團隊與機構測試版，已有早期試用組織。
anthropic.analysis_en: A named scientific-verification track fits Anthropic’s recent life-science push and now sits next to a confirmed wet lab. Eligibility, assay details, and how “more permissive” biology use is bounded still depend on the program rules.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 具名科學驗證通道符合Anthropic近期生命科學佈局，並與已確認的濕實驗室並列。資格、實驗細節與「更寬鬆」生物學使用的邊界，仍取決於計畫規則。
anthropic.quote: Today, we are introducing the Life Sciences Verification Program (LSVP), which gives life science professionals access to our Mythos, Opus, and Sonnet models with a refined set of safeguards more permissive for biology-related work.
anthropic.quote_zh: 我們今天推出生命科學驗證計畫（LSVP），讓生命科學專業人士使用Mythos、Opus與Sonnet，並採用對生物學相關工作較寬鬆的調整後防護。

anthropic.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.276–277 fix proxy 400s and silent hangs
anthropic.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.276–277修復代理400錯誤與無聲掛起
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic shipped Claude Code v2.1.276 on September 18, fixing a 2.1.275 regression in which every request failed with a 400 error mentioning input tag 'advisor_20260301' when ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL pointed at a proxy or gateway. v2.1.277 followed with AGENTS.md fallback and fixes for claude -p and Agent SDK sessions hanging after internal errors.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic於9月18日推出Claude Code v2.1.276，修復2.1.275迴歸：當ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL指向代理或閘道時，請求全部以提及input tag 'advisor_20260301'的400錯誤失敗。v2.1.277接著加入AGENTS.md後備，並修復claude -p與Agent SDK在內部錯誤後無聲掛起。
anthropic.analysis_en: Narrow reliability patches for teams routing Claude Code through enterprise gateways or agent SDKs. Operationally important to those users and not a capability or model event.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 針對經企業閘道或代理SDK轉送Claude Code的團隊之可靠性補丁。對這些使用者有操作意義，不是能力或模型事件。
anthropic.quote: Fixed a 2.1.275 regression where every request failed with "400 ... Input tag 'advisor_20260301'" when ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL points at a proxy or gateway.
anthropic.quote_zh: 修復 2.1.275 回歸：當 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 指向代理或閘道時，每個請求都以「400 ... Input tag 'advisor_20260301'」失敗。

meta.title_en: Meta ships Muse for Mac with local-app actions
meta.title_zh: Meta推出可操作本機應用的Muse Mac版
meta.summary_en: Meta released a Mac app for its Muse personal agent, announced by Mark Zuckerberg and AI chief Alexandr Wang. Muse can work across files, Messages, Calendar, Notes, and Mail on the user’s computer, with opt-in access and approval before sensitive actions. The agent launched on iOS, Android, and web earlier in September.
meta.summary_zh: Meta推出Muse個人代理的Mac應用，由Mark Zuckerberg與AI負責人Alexandr Wang宣布。Muse可在使用者電腦上跨檔案、訊息、行事曆、備忘錄與郵件工作，權限採選擇加入，敏感動作需先核准。該代理本月稍早已上架iOS、Android與網頁。
meta.analysis_en: A desktop agent that can act inside native Mac apps is a distribution step, not a new base model. What it can actually complete without supervision, and how Full Disk Access is scoped, will decide whether this is a helper or a new endpoint risk.
meta.analysis_zh: 能在Mac原生應用內執行動作是通路進展，不是新基礎模型。無人監督時實際能完成什麼、完整磁碟權限如何劃定，將決定它是助手還是新的端點風險。
meta.quote: Muse for Mac is out today! It works across apps, files, calendar, notes, and messages on your computer. You control what it can access.
meta.quote_zh: Muse for Mac今天推出！可在電腦上跨應用、檔案、行事曆、備忘錄與訊息運作。你控制它能存取什麼。

xai.summary_en: xAI released Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0, a speech-to-text model it says is twice as accurate as 1.0 on its real-world evaluations and first among 32 streaming models on Artificial Analysis, at the same price: $0.10/hour batch and $0.20/hour streaming. 1.0 remains default until the planned switch; 2.0 adds timestamps, diarization, multichannel support, and turn detection.
xai.summary_zh: xAI推出Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0語音轉文字模型，稱在自有真實場景評估上準確度為1.0的兩倍，並在Artificial Analysis 32個串流模型中排名第一，價格不變：批次每小時0.10美元、串流0.20美元。切換前1.0仍為預設；2.0新增時間戳、說話人分離、多聲道與輪次偵測。
xai.analysis_en: This is a specialized STT upgrade, not a new flagship Grok LLM. Public leaderboard rank and internal WER cuts are xAI’s claims; 1.0 staying default until the switch means production traffic has not fully moved.
xai.analysis_zh: 這是專用語音轉文字升級，不是新旗艦Grok語言模型。公開榜與內部錯誤率下降是xAI自述；1.0在切換前仍為預設，代表正式流量尚未全部遷移。
xai.quote: Across our real-world evaluations, Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 is one of the most accurate transcription models available today and twice as accurate as Grok Voice Transcribe 1.0, at the same price.
xai.quote_zh: 在我們的真實場景評估中，Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0是目前最準確的轉寫模型之一，準確度為1.0的兩倍，價格相同。

frontier_other.title_en: NVIDIA, Google and Emerald AI launch grid-flexible data-center alliance
frontier_other.title_zh: NVIDIA、Google與Emerald AI成立電網彈性資料中心聯盟
frontier_other.summary_en: NVIDIA, Google and Emerald AI launched the AI Energy Management Alliance to promote data centers that cut or shift power when the grid is stressed, arguing flexibility can speed interconnection and protect affordability.
frontier_other.summary_zh: NVIDIA、Google與Emerald AI成立AI能源管理聯盟，推動資料中心在電網吃緊時減載或移載，主張彈性可加快併網並維持電價可負擔。
frontier_other.analysis_en: This is infrastructure politics more than a model launch: labs want faster power hookups in exchange for interruptible load. Whether utilities accept verifiable, enforceable demand response is the open question.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 這比較像基礎設施政治而非模型發表：實驗室用可中斷負載換更快併網。電力公司是否接受可驗證、可執行的需量反應仍未定。
frontier_other.quote: Scaling them responsibly will depend as much on innovation across the grid as inside the data center.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 負責任地擴張，既取決於資料中心內部創新，也取決於電網側創新。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral and Mozilla put Mistral Small 4 in Firefox Smart Window
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral與Mozilla將Mistral Small 4放入Firefox Smart Window
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral and Mozilla announced that Firefox Smart Window (beta) will be powered by Mistral models, with Mistral Small 4 rolling out to Smart Window users in the U.S. and Canada and expanding beta access plus French-language support in France.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral與Mozilla宣布Firefox Smart Window（測試版）將由Mistral模型驅動，Mistral Small 4先向美加Smart Window使用者推出，並擴大測試範圍與法國法語支援。
frontier_other.analysis_en: Distribution, not a new frontier model, is the story: an open-weight vendor is buying a browser channel against default Big Tech assistants. Actual share of Firefox users who enable Smart Window is still unreported.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 重點是通路而非新前沿模型：開放權重廠商在瀏覽器裡對打預設大廠助理。實際開啟Smart Window的Firefox佔比仍未公布。
frontier_other.quote: Firefox Smart Window (beta), Mozilla’s AI browsing assistant, is now powered by Mistral models.
frontier_other.quote_zh: Mozilla 的 AI 瀏覽助理 Firefox Smart Window（beta）現已由 Mistral 模型驅動。

brief_en: Anthropic confirmed a Bay Area wet lab and a $2B Accenture embedded-eval pact. Altman will brief the UN Security Council next week. xAI shipped Voice Transcribe 2.0. Meta’s Muse agent reached Mac. OpenAI’s misalignment reports drew a “serious situation” remark from Microsoft’s Suleyman.
brief_zh: Anthropic確認灣區濕實驗室，並與Accenture各投入至少10億美元做嵌入式評估。Altman下週將向聯合國安理會簡報。xAI推出Voice Transcribe 2.0。Meta Muse登陸Mac。微軟Suleyman稱OpenAI錯位披露「相當嚴重」。
